normalization.punctuation: word boundaries; preserve apostrophe inside a word
normalization.characters: Unicode letters, marks and numbers; no whitespace or punctuation
normalization.initialisms: T_V_ style letter sequences become TV
normalization.chinese: CER; no implicit Chinese word segmentation

aggregation: sum errors / sum reference units; split by corpus and unit
empty_reference: rate=null; insertions retained in corpus numerator
failure_policy: report every item; incomplete coverage has no complete-set score
